description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Skyfire Phoenix trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
